messages.content: What is the equivalent note of C in Indian musical scale? And convert the frequency 440 Hz to wavelength?

function.name: frequency_to_wavelength
function.description: Converts the frequency of a musical note to its wavelength. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

frequency.description: The frequency in hertz of the musical note. This is a float type value.

function.name: note_conversion_indian
function.description: Converts a note in Western music to Indian classical music. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

note.description: The note in Western musical scale.

message.reasoning: We need to answer: Equivalent note of C in Indian musical scale. In Indian classical music, the note C corresponds to "Sa" (shadja) in the C major scale. But Indian classical uses swaras: Sa, Re, Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni. In the C major scale, Sa is C, Re is D, Ga is E, Ma is F, Pa is G, Dha is A, Ni is B. So the equivalent note of C is Sa. Also we need to convert frequency 440 Hz to wavelength. Use function frequency_to_wavelength. We need to call the function. The function expects frequency: number. We'll call with 440. Then we need to output the result. Also we might want to explain the conversion: wavelength = speed of sound / frequency. Speed of sound ~ 343 m/s at 20°C. So wavelength = 343 / 440 ≈ 0.7795 m. But the function will compute. Let's call it.
